description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join a small, senior team building an AI-powered executive assistant that handles real work across communication and productivity tools. You will develop agent capabilities and evaluation systems that help ensure tasks are completed reliably before new features reach users.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build agents that complete executive workflows end to end with minimal oversight.

 - Define and measure task success with trusted evaluation frameworks and representative datasets.

 - Develop new agent capabilities and validate their performance before launch.

 - Investigate production failures, identify underlying causes, and deliver fixes that prevent recurrence.

 - Build scaled systems to detect known failure patterns and unexpected issues.

 - Improve agent resilience when external tools or websites fail.

 - Create repeatable methods for engineers to measure the impact of agent changes.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least 3 years of experience in data science or machine learning, including evaluation systems, metrics, or product quality measurement.

 - Production-quality Python and SQL skills for analysis, large datasets, and automated pipelines.

 - Experience designing evaluation frameworks, selecting meaningful metrics, and building representative test datasets.

 - A track record delivering production AI, machine learning, agent, or agent-evaluation systems to real users.

 - Experience owning systems end to end and using statistics, experiment design, and realistic simulations to assess changes.

 - Familiarity with post-training, fine-tuning, or reinforcement learning is valuable.

 - Experience with Django, React, and TypeScript; exposure to evaluation tools such as Braintrust or Raindrop is useful.

 - A record of startup experience or sustained growth and promotion at one organization, strong engineering fundamentals, and up to 11 years of experience.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary: $200,000 to $300,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is not available.


LOCATION

On-site in Palo Alto, California.
